title: Agent-Conditioned Routing: Diverse Reasoning Paths Within One Frozen Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.37375v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generating several solutions can expose alternative methods, but additional trajectories often paraphrase one dominant approach. We investigate whether the conditional capacity of a frozen sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) model can provide such diversity from one problem prompt, without user-assigned roles, prescribed methods, fine-tuning, or model copies. Agent-Conditioned Routing (ACR) assigns $m$ parallel trajectories persistent, untrained shared/private expert-eligibility masks while preserving the learned, input-dependent token router. On a screened 126-question multi-mode mathematics and physics benchmark, with model judges reading the reported derivations in full, we count the number of problems yielding at least two distinct primary methods among soft-correct solutions in four trajectories. translated_title: 智能体条件化路由：单个冻结模型内实现多样化推理路径
translated_abstract: 生成多个解决方案可以揭示不同的方法，但额外的轨迹往往只是对某一种主导方法的同义改写。我们研究一个冻结的稀疏混合专家模型的条件化能力能否在单一问题提示下提供这种多样性，而无需用户指定角色、预设方法、微调或模型副本。智能体条件化路由（ACR）为m条并行轨迹分配持久的、未经训练的共享/私有专家资格掩码，同时保留已学习的、依赖输入的token路由器。在一个经过筛选的126题多模式数学和物理基准上，由模型裁判完整阅读报告的推导过程，我们统计在四条轨迹的软正确解中产生至少两种不同主要方法的问题数量。ACR在GLM 5.3下达到的问题数量约为最强温度设置的两倍（37.3对18.7），并达到……的1.67倍
tldr: 提出智能体条件化路由（ACR），通过为冻结MoE模型的并行轨迹分配持久的专家资格掩码，在无需微调、角色指定或模型副本的情况下，使单个模型产生真正多样化的推理路径，其方法多样性约为温度采样最强设置的两倍。
en_tdlr: Agent-Conditioned Routing (ACR) assigns persistent expert-eligibility masks to parallel trajectories within a frozen MoE model, enabling genuinely diverse reasoning paths without fine-tuning, role assignment, or model copies, achieving roughly twice the method diversity of the strongest temperature sampling setting.
